name: JCS Technologies Inc.
old_description: JCS Technologies specializes in high-quality wire harness design, prototyping and manufacturing.
about:
JCS Technologies Inc. operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it was founded in 2011. The company is privately held; no specific ownership designation such as veteran-, woman-, or family-owned is stated in its public materials. It began with a focus on wire harness design, prototyping, and manufacturing, aiming to eliminate the unreliability the founders observed in the supply chain.

The company specializes in the full lifecycle of wire harnesses: design assistance, rapid prototyping with no minimum order quantities, and low-volume manufacturing. Its recent move to a larger facility supports a commitment to on-time delivery. Every unit is 100% tested before shipment, and the firm backs its work with a 0% Failure Rate Guarantee that includes free replacement within 48 hours. Headcount and annual volume figures are not disclosed, but the business emphasizes fast turnaround on small-to-medium runs rather than high-volume production.

JCS serves four primary sectors: casino gaming equipment, renewable energy (controllers, generators), industrial electronics (consumer devices, kiosks, ATMs, computers), and amusement systems (audio, video, control, and payment integration). Named customers include Light & Wonder and Asahi Seiko, both cited for the speed and quality of delivered harnesses.

The company was started to end an era of acceptable fail rates. Its stated differentiators are a zero-failure guarantee, no minimums, quick turnaround on low-volume orders, individual product testing, and compliance with UL and RoHS standards.

JDM Supply LLC is based in Mesa, Arizona, and was founded in 2002. The company operates as a distributor of new and used electrical equipment, serving customers through an online store and a physical location in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies a range of electrical components including circuit breakers, motor controls, starters, contactors, electrical panels, panelboard switches, and fuses. It maintains an inventory of both new and used items and offers emergency delivery within the Phoenix metro area without additional fees. The business operates six days a week, with hours from 6:30 AM to 4 PM on weekdays and 8 AM to noon on Saturdays.

JDM Supply serves electrical contractors, industrial maintenance departments, and commercial facilities that require replacement or upgrade components. The company emphasizes building long-term relationships and provides support for urgent needs, such as emergency breakdowns, without charging opening fees.

The company states that it was started to solve customer problems without penalizing them with extra fees during emergencies. Its differentiators include free local delivery, no emergency opening charges, and a commitment to going the extra mile for customers.

name: JEH Solar LLC
old_description: Lafayette, LA's premier solar power and electrical contractors with 30 Years of Experience. Serving all of Louisiana and parts of Texas.
about:
JEH Solar LLC is a solar and electrical contracting company based in Lafayette, Louisiana. Founded in 1996, the locally owned business has spent nearly three decades serving homeowners and businesses across South Louisiana and parts of Texas.

The company provides full‑service design, installation, and maintenance of solar power systems, electrical infrastructure, and backup generators. Its NABCEP‑certified team handles residential and commercial projects from engineering and permitting through commissioning, including off‑grid solar arrays, generator integration, electrical panel upgrades, and lighting work. The firm also offers project management and job‑site supervision on every install.

JEH Solar serves both residential and commercial customers. Residential clients rely on the company for rooftop solar, whole‑home backup power, and general electrical service. Commercial accounts include retail, industrial, and institutional facilities needing new construction wiring, solar arrays, and preventive maintenance. The company’s service area covers the Lafayette and Baton Rouge metros and surrounding parishes.

A stated differentiator is the firm’s national teaching role: its technicians travel the country instructing other contractors on solar installation and maintenance practices. Combined with NABCEP certification and a local ownership structure, the company positions itself as a turnkey energy contractor for the Gulf Coast region.

old_description: For five decades, JMC Wood Manufacturing has built its reputation on providing high-quality wood lamination and fabricated part solutions to its customers. Over the years, we’ve developed an impressive array of manufacturing resources.  But the heart of our operation is the extra attention and service we give our customers.  The following is a summary of JMC’s services and capabilities:
about:
JMC Manufacturing Co, operating as JMC Wood Manufacturing, is based in Bridgeton, Missouri. The company has been operating for five decades, building a reputation in wood lamination and fabricated part solutions. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in laminating papers, vinyls, HPL, FRP, aluminum, and other overlays to substrates such as particleboard, plywood, MDF, and gypsum using proprietary gluing formulas (KissCoat, PopFree, HPBond). It also offers membrane pressing (PressFit) for three-dimensional contours, miter-folding with an 8-foot wide seven-head machine, moldings up to 9 inches wide via eight-head and seven-head molders, T-molding, profile wrapping up to 19 inches wide using WRAPtight PUR adhesive technology, boring and routing on seven CNC routers, straight-line and contour edge banding (with an IMA contour edge bander for 4x10 tops), and cut-to-size parts on two CNC panel saws with a 61-by-145-inch sheet capacity and a tolerance of ±1/32 inch.

JMC serves customers in the building products sector, as evidenced by a testimonial from PortaKing Building Products. The company's capabilities suggest it also supports cabinetry, furniture, and fixture manufacturers, though specific industries beyond building products are not explicitly listed.

JMC emphasizes its proprietary adhesive technologies and the breadth of its in-house equipment as key differentiators, stating that few competitors match its full range of woodworking and lamination capabilities. The company highlights extra attention and service as the heart of its operation.

name: JMH Woodcraft Inc
old_description: New York City's Premier Custom Carpentry Design and Building Specialists
about:
Founded in 1926 in New York City, JMH Woodcraft Inc. has operated as a custom carpentry and cabinetmaking shop for nearly a century. The company serves the five boroughs from its Manhattan base, offering design, fabrication, and installation for residential and commercial projects.

The shop produces custom carpentry pieces including kitchen islands, built-in bookcases, radiator covers, wall units, and entertainment centers. Its capabilities span solid-wood construction, stain matching, customized molding, antique restoration, total design integration, expert installation, and painting and repair. As a small firm, JMH Woodcraft emphasizes personalized attention on projects of any scale, from single built-ins to full commercial fit-outs.

Clients range from homeowners to institutional and commercial accounts. Recent commercial projects include work for Mount Sinai School of Medicine, Christ and St. Stephens Church, V&T's Restaurant, Firehouse Restaurant, Manhattan School for Children, Booker T. Washington Jr. High School, Beacon High School, and The Hungarian Pastry Shop. The company also serves residential customers throughout New York City.

JMH Woodcraft cites its small size as a key advantage, allowing personalized service on even the smallest jobs that larger contractors cannot accommodate. The firm highlights its reputation for craftsmanship, attention to detail, clear communication, honesty, and integrity, backed by a long list of satisfied clients and a standing offer of free consultations.

old_description: Mobile welding and in house welding repair and fabrication. Steel, aluminum, stainless steel, cast iron, cast steel, stairs, railing, on site welding, equipment repair.
about:
JMW Fabrication, operating as JMW Specialty Welding and Fabrication, was founded in 2003 in Quakertown, Pennsylvania. The company provides mobile welding and in-house fabrication services from its shop in eastern Pennsylvania.

The shop runs CNC plasma cutting, press brake, iron worker, and automated cold saws, supporting processes such as SMAW, GMAW, and GTAW welding on steel, stainless steel, aluminum, cast iron, and cast steel. Capacity reaches thousands of pieces per day across small, medium, and large production runs, covering structural, architectural, stair, railing, repair, and prototype work.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial sectors throughout eastern Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Projects range from floating stairs and modern railings for homes to structural fabrication for commercial and industrial clients.

The company emphasizes long-term customer relationships over one-off jobs, with AWS‑certified welders (D1.1, D1.3, D9.1) and a mobile fleet that includes propane‑powered rigs for indoor welding. All major equipment is American‑made, and the firm prioritizes planning, communication, and craftsmanship quality.

name: JPM Steel Fabrication
old_description: Founded in 2010, JPM Fabrication is a Veteran-Owned (VOSB) and Family-Operated business in NW Arkansas. We started from humble beginnings and have been blessed to gain the trust of our customers across the country.
about:
JPM Steel Fabrication was founded in 2010 in Bella Vista, Arkansas, by James P. McGary, an Army veteran who served in Iraq from 2003 to 2005. After years working in concrete construction and storage-solution installation, McGary saw a shortage of skilled steel fabricators in the region and opened his own shop. The business is certified as a Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) and is family-operated; McGary’s wife Erin, also an Army veteran, helps run the household while his brothers often lead installation crews.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom tension-fabric storage buildings—often called hoop sheds or fabric domes—for bulk materials such as grain, sand, salt, hay, and equipment. Beyond the fabric structures, JPM provides full-service maintenance, repair, retrofit (including “retrodomes” on existing foundations), cover replacement, and building relocation. The shop has grown from a single crew to multiple full-time steel fabricators, installation specialists, and office staff, and it also produces consumer items like steel benches and fire pits while performing general contracting for municipalities and large-scale commercial customizations.

JPM serves agriculture (farms, fisheries, grain storage), government and municipal agencies (salt and sand storage, maintenance buildings), waste and recycling facilities, aviation (aircraft hangars), mining operations, equestrian centers, port and intermodal terminals, and railroad depots. Customers range from individual farmers and construction companies to city, state, and federal agencies across the continental United States.

The founders started the business to fill a local gap in skilled steel fabrication and to carry on a tradition of tradesmanship. The company emphasizes a “cut materials, not corners” philosophy, with the founder personally involved in every project from design through installation. Differentiators include a 25-year warranty on fabricated buildings, two years of included maintenance, engineer-approved designs, and a commitment to inspecting every component before it leaves the shop.
